description: Schema for the dependency ratchet audit report

audit.description: Results of reconciling the static dependency graph with the runtime scan and auditing enforcement levels

undeclared_dependencies.description: Dependencies found in the runtime scan that are absent from the static dependency graph in the SQLite database. Sorted by (source, target).

evidence.description: Module path from the runtime scan providing evidence of this dependency

invalid_levels.description: Packages whose current enforcement level produces violations on the complete (static + runtime) dependency graph. Sorted by package name.

current_level.description: The declared enforcement level that is invalid

max_valid_level.description: The highest enforcement level at which this package has zero violations

violations.description: All dependency edges that violate the source package's current (pre-correction) enforcement level on the complete graph. Sorted by (package, dependency).

package.description: Package whose enforcement level is violated

dependency.description: Target package causing or connected to the violation

cycles.description: All strongly connected components of size >= 2 in the complete dependency graph. Each component is a sorted list of package names. The list of components is sorted by first element.

critical_edges.description: A set of dependency edges whose removal makes the entire complete graph acyclic. Sorted lexicographically by (source, target).

promotable.description: Packages that can be promoted to a higher enforcement level from their corrected (post-rollback) level. Report the highest achievable level for each. Sorted by package name.

migration_plan.description: Ordered sequence of single-level promotions starting from corrected enforcement levels, following the ratchet policy's migration rules
